source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 借势救人，少年周旋
title: 借势救人，少年周旋
purpose: 承接 SC17 住手之后：拓拔野顺势假借青帝之名发令救人；黑衣众人将段聿铠抬到门边；科沙度与十四郎起疑试探；拓拔野硬着头皮周旋，白衣女子暗中相助。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、牌匾文字或任何可读文本。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt around 你们将这姓段的抬到门口来 / 野野 / 科沙度试探 / 唐七请赐教。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 and SH02 anchor to the SC17 stop-command / gate-peril storyboard so gate geography stays stable. SH03 and SH04 anchor to the corrected SC17 stop-command storyboard so Tuobaye, the white-clothed woman, and the white dragon-deer stay in the same hidden-courtyard layout.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, threats, taunts, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 你们将这姓段的抬到门口来。
你们都退下去，转过身去。
在下单名一个野字。你叫我野野即可。
